verdict.rationale: Kit's official remote MCP exposes a creator's account, explicitly including segments and tags, to AI clients with read and write access. Its docs say natural-language prompts like "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week" become real account actions, and broadcasts can target segment or tag IDs. However, no evidence documents that an agent can create or define a new segment from a plain-language audience description; the evidence shows targeting existing segments or tags, not building them. Missing for 10: a documented segment-creation or segment-filter-definition endpoint or MCP tool, an example of a natural-language audience description turned into a saved segment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
